sections.content: Async programming handles many tasks without waiting — fetching web data, timers, parallel downloads. Instead of blocking, you schedule work and continue.
Callbacks, promises, and async/await are common patterns. The key mental shift: operations that take time should not freeze the whole program.
Key points: async code runs "later", ordering is not guaranteed unless you await, and race conditions appear when tasks share state.

sections.codeExample:
; fetch data without blocking the UI
; await getData()  // pause THIS function only
